scope: Bounded target-record and occurrence-geometry preparation only. No new research, package build, or repo modification.

baseline.description: Successful 2026-09-21 fresh-data QA mineral indexes after recent evidence-filter work; production unchanged.
baseline.dedupe_method: normalized state + exact mineral/variety + locality-name reconciliation; combined localities split before final classification

decision_rule.existing_target_binding: Bind only when one unambiguous exact existing GroundRove locality record is identified.
decision_rule.otherwise: Do not force a match. Keep the mineral/locality relationship as a separate occurrence candidate.
decision_rule.geometry: Use only geometry already explicit in verified staging/current exact target. Do not invent or infer coordinates.
